changes.text: `closeLabel` (default `'Close'`) names a new close button that shows below 768px, where the palette is full-screen and has no backdrop to tap. The input now sits in a `.bar` row together with that `button.close`.
`resultsText` (default `n result` / `n results`) is announced through an always-rendered `role="status"` node once a query is typed; with no matches it announces `emptyText`.
The page behind no longer scrolls while the palette is open. It uses the same reference-counted scroll lock as `Modal`, so a palette opened over a modal unwinds correctly.
Result rows use logical properties (`border-inline-start`, `padding-inline-start`, `text-align: start`), so the active rail and text alignment mirror under `dir="rtl"`.
Rows that are links (`href` items) no longer show the global animated link underline from `theme.css`; the reset lives in the component's own CSS, so it ships in `vanilla.css` too.

New component: a Cmd/Ctrl+K search and command palette, a native `<dialog>` holding a combobox over a grouped listbox. It takes `items` (`id`, `label`, `hint`, `href`, `group`, `keywords`, `disabled`), filters them itself (`filter={false}` with bindable `query` hands filtering to you), navigates `href` items through real `<a>` links, and offers `onselect` / `onopen` / `onclose`, `item` / `empty` / `footer` snippets and `size`.

The `shortcut` prop (`'mod+k'` by default, `false` to disable) registers the toggle in the `shortcuts` registry as `ss:search-palette`, so it lists in `ShortcutsHelp` and obeys `setEnabled()` / `remap()`. `mod+k` means the platform modifier only: Cmd+K on macOS, Ctrl+K elsewhere.
